card.name: Positions where "he" or "his" comes next
card.fires_on: Punctuation and linking words (commas, of, against, which) in biographical or narrative text about a male person, right where a masculine pronoun such as he or his is expected next.

modes.label: Comma before he
modes.description: A comma ending a clause about a man, after which he or his is likely to start the next clause.
modes.example: she for the ending of slavery (if by war, then let it be so<<),>> he for the constitution first

modes.label: Link word before his
modes.description: A preposition or relative word in a phrase about a male subject, followed by his or him.
modes.example: So it seems curious for a man<< of>> his station and the way he wanted to

modes.label: Noun after his
modes.description: A noun such as travels or life after his, with he likely to follow.
modes.example: Late in his<< life>> he returned to the south of France as

card.writes: It pushes the model to continue with masculine pronouns (his, he) and away from feminine ones (she, her).
card.plain: It marks spots in a story about a man where the next word is likely to be he or his.
